title: High Cholesterol
summary: Diet and activity alongside your doctor's care
ayurvedicView: High cholesterol is linked to excess Kapha and meda (fat tissue). Lighter food, activity and "scraping" (lekhana) herbs are the traditional approach; medicines are often needed as well.
remedies: One to two teaspoons of isabgol (psyllium husk) a day, which modestly lowers LDL cholesterol
A tablespoon of ground alsi (flaxseed) in food
Less ghee, butter, coconut oil and fried food
At least 30 minutes of brisk walking on most days
Take prescribed medicines such as statins as advised, and tell your doctor about any herbs you use
prevention: Get your cholesterol checked from your 30s, or earlier with a family history of heart disease
Stay active and keep a healthy weight
tips: Fill half the plate with vegetables
Choose whole grains and dals over refined flour
Cut down on sweets and packaged snacks
seeDoctor: Chest pain or pressure, breathlessness, or pain spreading to the arm or jaw: call 112
A family history of heart attack before 55 in men or 65 in women
Muscle pain or weakness after starting a statin
